purpose: Teach: アットホーム/ともなっ/見なし/三四郎/インテリジェント/平年/山川/加護

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アットホームな雰囲気のレストランがいい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned he'd like a restaurant with a warm, homey feel.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational tone. Relaying her husband's preference as though sharing an everyday detail. Warm without being heavy. Natural pause before the main idea.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「困難をともなっても続けなさい」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to keep going even when things get hard.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Speaking carefully, as if the words matter. Small boy reporting something important he was taught. No performance—just earnest delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「正解と見なして良い回答」って褒めて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad praised you—he said your answer was exactly right.
lines.style: Soft approval in her voice. Pleased on his behalf. Measured pace. The kind of parental warmth that comes from witnessing something good happen to your child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと夏目漱石の「三四郎」を読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read Natsume Soseki's Sanshiro together.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Speaking about something he valued. Small, genuine pleasure—not bragging, just sharing. Soft close on the last word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「インテリジェントな会話を楽しもう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad wants you two to have thoughtful conversations together.
lines.style: Relaying her husband's intention with gentle appreciation. Acknowledging the value he places on their connection. Warm, intentional pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと平年の気温の変化を観察したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched how the temperature changes through the year.
lines.style: Simple, observant tone. A six-year-old sharing something he noticed with his father. Genuine interest, not performing knowledge. Steady, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと地理で山川の地形を学ぶ予定よ
lines.en: Sho, you and Dad are going to learn about mountains and rivers in geography.
lines.style: Light forward-looking tone. Sharing plans. Warm but unsentimental. The voice of a mother noting what her son will experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「神様の加護があるよ」って優しく言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me softly that God watches over me.
lines.style: Hushed, tender delivery. A small child repeating something gentle he was told. Reverent without being heavy. Trailing close as if holding onto the moment.
